origin.summary: Workout 2 of the 2024 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 20-minute AMRAP of a 300m row, deadlifts, and double-unders.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2024/2 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
